title: ExampleBrand 5-Slot Desk Cable Organizer, Flexible Silicone Cord Holder
bullets: KEEPS EVERYDAY CABLES WITHIN REACH — Five separate slots organize 2–6 mm charging and accessory cords along a desk edge.
FLEXIBLE SLOT DESIGN — Silicone construction holds compatible round cables without adding a rigid edge to the work surface.
MADE FOR SMOOTH SURFACES — The adhesive backing mounts to a clean, dry, smooth non-porous desk or nightstand surface.
COMPACT FIVE-SLOT FORMAT — The 3.5 x 0.8 x 0.6 in organizer provides five routing positions; measure cables and the mounting area first.
ONE ORGANIZER INCLUDED — The package contains one five-slot organizer; wipe it with a soft cloth for routine care.
description: Create a tidier charging area without repeatedly searching behind the desk. This five-slot desk cable organizer keeps compatible 2–6 mm accessory cords in predictable positions. Its 3.5 x 0.8 x 0.6 in silicone body is designed for clean, dry, smooth non-porous desks and nightstands. Measure cable diameter and the mounting area before installation. Apply the included adhesive backing to the prepared surface and wipe the organizer with a soft cloth as needed. Package includes one five-slot cable organizer.
